classification.difficultyReason: Sketch a given linear function after reflection, vertical translations and a vertical dilation.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=-(4x+2)\\y&=-4x-2\end{align*}$$
Reflect $y=h(x)$ in the $x$-axis. The intercepts are $(-\tfrac12,0)$ and $(0,-2)$; draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Completed reflected straight line with its two intercepts; no grid or origin label.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=4x+2+5\\y&=4x+7\end{align*}$$
Translate $y=h(x)$ upwards 5 units. The intercepts are $(-\tfrac74,0)$ and $(0,7)$; draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Completed translated straight line with its two intercepts.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=4x+2-2\\y&=4x\end{align*}$$
Translate $y=h(x)$ downwards 2 units. Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(1,4)$.

spec.description: Completed straight line through the origin and (1,4); the second point fixes its gradient.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=2(4x+2)\\y&=8x+4\end{align*}$$
Stretch $y=h(x)$ from the $x$-axis by a factor of 2, doubling each ordinate. The intercepts are $(-\tfrac12,0)$ and $(0,4)$; draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Completed vertically dilated straight line with its two intercepts.
